appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the app looks. This choice is kept on this phone.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language of the app. This choice is kept on this phone.

sync.title: Background sync
sync.description: The sync sends the steps of the last 30 days about every 6 hours, even when the app is not open (if Health Connect allows background access).

huawei.title: Huawei Health
huawei.description: Connect Step Challenge to Huawei Health so that it can read your steps.

sources.title: Step sources
sources.description: The apps that record your steps in Health Connect today, and the total Step Challenge uses.
sources.androidOnly: Step sources are only available in the Android app.

friends.title: Friends
friends.intro: Only your friends see your steps, and you only see theirs.
friends.empty: No friends yet. Share an invitation link: everyone who opens it and accepts joins your friends list.

invite.message: Join me on Step Challenge to compare our steps! Open this link (valid for 7 days): {{url}}
invite.tooMany: You already have too many active invitation links. Deactivate one below, or wait for it to expire.

invitations.hint: For security, the app does not keep the links: to invite someone else, create a new link.

revoke.title: Deactivate this link?
revoke.message: Nobody will be able to use it to become your friend anymore. Friends who already accepted it remain your friends.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: You will no longer see each other's steps. Your invitation links still active will be deactivated.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.message: You will no longer be friends, and {{name}} will not be able to become your friend again, even with an invitation link. {{name}} is not notified.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.message: You do not become friends again automatically: a new invitation link will be needed.

blocked.hint: They can no longer become your friends and do not know they are blocked.

rename.hint: Only you can see this name.

invitation.title: Invitation

errors.friendLimit: The friend limit has been reached.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.generic: Cannot process this invitation. Check your connection.

invalid.title: Invalid invitation link
invalid.text: This link has expired or has been deactivated. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.

blocked.title: {{name}} is blocked
blocked.text: This person will not be able to become your friend. You can unblock them from the Friends screen.

accepted.title: Done!
accepted.text: You and {{name}} are now friends: you appear in each other's leaderboard.

invitation.own: This is your own invitation: share this link with your friends so that they join you.
invitation.invites: {{name}} invites you to become friends. You will see each other's steps in the leaderboard.

weekRank.lead_one: You're in the lead, {{steps}} step ahead of {{name}} 🥇
weekRank.lead_other: You're in the lead, {{steps}} steps ahead of {{name}} 🥇

streak.isRecord_other: Current streak of {{days}} days: it's your record!

leaderboard.emptyTitle: The leaderboard is played among friends

report.title: Report {{name}}
report.hint: Your report is read by the Step Challenge team. The reported person is not notified.
report.error: Cannot send the report. Try again later.
report.offerBlock: Do you also want to block {{name}}? You will no longer be friends, and this person will not be able to become your friend again, even with an invitation link. They are not notified.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.message:
Your account, your name and all your step history will be permanently deleted from the Step Challenge server. The Health Connect data on your phone is not affected.

This cannot be undone.

signIn.explanation: Sign in with your Google account. Step Challenge only keeps a technical identifier: neither your email nor your photo.
signIn.networkError: Cannot sign in. Check your internet connection and try again.

googleErrors.configuration: Invalid Google configuration (Android OAuth client, package or SHA-1).
googleErrors.play-services: Google Play services are missing or need an update.
googleErrors.unavailable: Sign-in is only available in the Android app.

demo.title: Demo access
demo.hint: For app store reviewers only: enter the access code given with the review instructions.

demoErrors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.

name.question: What's your name?
name.hint: This is the name the other participants will see. You can change it later.

sources.title: Step sources (today)
sources.none: No app has recorded steps in Health Connect in the last 30 days.
sources.hint: Health Connect merges every source and removes duplicates according to the priority order set in its settings (Health Connect → Data and access → Activity → Steps): the total is not the sum of the sources. Step Challenge uses this total.
